Value-Added Services Included at No Additional Charge
Miller Johnson provides many resources to its clients at no cost. Some are educational resources
that include client alerts, webinars, podcasts, blogs, newsletters, and video updates. Others are
discussing and considering more theoretical implications of what a particular client’s project may
have on an unbilled basis as it does not directly apply to the project at hand.
The main area we provide a value-add, however, is in the Miller Johnson approach to these types of
transactions and interactions with counterparties and clients. As indicated, we take a partnership
approach with the client in which we don’t only advise of legal risks and leave the client to evaluate
those risks in light of the bigger picture and practical realties.
Rather, we endeavor to understand the client’s business, its pain points, its preferences, its strategies,
and its goals, and then apply that understanding to our analysis of the legal risks and the most
efficient, practical way to manage them. We look forward to doing the same for you.
